opening.quote: Agent: Good morning, Tidewell um Home, my name is Femke. How can I help today?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Customer: i sorry it got to that point, I can hear this has been a hassle. Could I take your full and the order number or postcode?
verification.comment: The agent asked for the full name and order number or postcode, but the transcript does not show the agent confirming the details before sharing order data, and the caller's name was only given as 'tim Smit' and used as 'Tom' so it was not properly confirmed.

understanding.quote: Agent: Thank your, Tom. I can see order 639184, a rug at €110.00. So you've opened a dispute with your bank about this payment?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the dispute issue and the order details, though the name was misheard as Tom instead of Tim Smit.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Bank disputes are handled by our paymentss team, so I've passed your case to them with all this details. They'll reply to you buy email within 3 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Policy says the Payments team replies within 2 working days, not 3, so the timeline stated was wrong.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Bank disputes are handled by our paymentss team, so I've passed your case to them with all this details.
process_compliance.comment: The agent correctly passed the bank dispute to the Payments team without handling it, but did not ask permission before any hold, which was not needed here.

communication.quote: Agent: theys will. You'll also get a case reference by email in the next hour. Is there anything else I can help you with?
communication.comment: The caller said she was not happy and the agent acknowledged the hassle, which was polite, though the agent's replies were brief and the name was mishandled.

closing.quote: Agent: Thanks for calling tide well, Tom. Have a good day.
closing.comment: The agent confirmed the next steps, asked if there was anything else, and closed politely, which meets the closing standard.
